risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to foreign exchange risk due to its international operations, particularly in Europe. Exchange rate fluctuations directly impact financial position and cash flows.

risks.title: Raw material price risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to raw material price volatility, particularly steel, and to the impact of tariffs on imported fasteners and anchors.

risks.title: Reputation risk
